The vendor directly providing **Zenfolio** at **zenfolio.com** is **Zenfolio, Inc.**

### Supporting Evidence
* According to the **Zenfolio Privacy Policy** (`zenfolio.com/privacy`):
  > *"This Privacy Policy sets forth the terms and conditions under which Zenfolio, Inc., and our affiliate Photobooker (collectively, 'Zenfolio,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our') collects, uses, and processes your personal information when you access or use any of our websites or services... Zenfolio offers two online platforms, one at www.zenfolio.com that allows photographers to exhibit, organize, print, sell, exchange, and share digital images, videos and related products..."*
* The official website footer and legal agreements (such as the Data Processing Agreement and API Terms) similarly designate **Zenfolio, Inc.** as the operating entity.
